test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following books was written by Dr. Raghuram Rajan?
solution:
The correct answer is__** The Third Pillar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The Third Pillar"** was written by **Dr. Raghuram Rajan.**
 
• **Dr. Raghuram Rajan is a renowned economist and the former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"We are Displaced"** is a book written by **Malala Yousafzai,** a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and education activist. 
 
• **"The India Story"** is a book written by **Dr. Pranab Mukherjee**, the former President of India. 
 
• **"My Life in Full"** is a book written by **Indra Nooyi.**
